Scenario fixture: menuitem-name-present (role="menuitem"/"menuitemcheckbox"/"menuitemradio" must have an accessible name)

Each target element has a stable id of the form menuitem_case_NN. Unlike combobox/listbox/textbox/searchbox/spinbutton/slider/dialog, menu items ARE name-from-content: visible subtree text is a valid fallback name source (priority: aria-label > aria-labelledby > title > content).

A. Baseline: mechanism priority order (eligible)

01 — FAIL: role=menuitem, no name at all, no content
02 — PASS: role=menuitem, visible text content (content fallback allowed here)
Cut
03 — PASS: role=menuitem, aria-label
📋
04 — PASS: role=menuitem, aria-labelledby
Paste
05 — PASS: role=menuitem, title
06 — FAIL: role=menuitem, content is aria-hidden (does not count)
Redo
07 — FAIL: role=menuitem, content is [hidden] (does not count)
Duplicate
08 — FAIL: role=menuitem, whitespace-only content
09 — PASS: role=menuitemcheckbox, content
Show toolbar
10 — FAIL: role=menuitemcheckbox, no name
11 — PASS: role=menuitemradio, content
List view
12 — FAIL: role=menuitemradio, no name

B. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

13 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true", not focusable, missing name
14 — EXCEPTION: aria-hidden="true" but focusable => eligible, missing name => FAIL

C. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

15 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
16 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
17 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
18 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

D. Inertness (ineligible)

19 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
20 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

End of fixture.
